papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2611.21057v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Similar tactile contacts can call for different corrections depending on the configuration of the hand, object and target. Rather than supplying touch and wrist vision separately, fusing them before policy injection better grounds tactile features in visual context, yielding more accurate contact representations. We introduce Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations (WiTac), a pretrained encoder that learns such representations before action gene
papers.reason: 指出相同触觉信号因手-物-目标构型不同需不同修正，因此在注入策略前融合腕部视觉与触觉，而非分开输入。触觉 VLA 表征设计的可直接复用方案。
